newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican protestors block Pemex well - Notimex.
newsitem.headline: Mexican protestors block Pemex well - Notimex.

text.p: Farmers from a local ranch in poor southern state Chiapas blocked access to a well of Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) in protest on Monday, state news agency Notimex reported.

The rare act of defiance against the oil monopoly was spurred by unresolved issues from a fatal explosion at the Cactus natural gas complex a year ago, town mayor Francisco Zavala Hidalgo told the agency.

Zavala said the farmers argue that Pemex has not resolved environmental and regional damages from the July 1996 blast. The Cactus natural gas complex explosion hiked natural gas imports for weeks, cost millions of dollars to repair and took seven lives.
Notimex did not specify the type of well the farmers were blocking. Pemex could not be reached for comment early Tuesday.
